Second, give the tool those examples in a form it can check itself against, then measure the drift over a week of real use. Third, keep a short list of the cases where it still fails and fix those one at a time rather than rewriting the whole setup. Most teams that do this see the output settle within a couple of weeks; the ones that skip the examples step keep editing every draft by hand.
